title: Amaraso ya mbere yamenetse mu ishyari
intro: Tekereza iminsi ya mbere y’abantu, igihe isi yose yari umuryango umwe. Ureba amaturo abiri ashyirwa imbere y’Imana - rimwe ryemerwa, irindi rikanga. Ishyari rishinga imizi mu mutima, kandi iterabwoba rivugishwa mu burakari. Ibikurikiraho bizasiga ikimenyetso mu mateka iteka ryose, ndetse n’inyoni nto izaba umwigisha.
clues: Ndi uwo mu muryango wa mbere ku isi.
Natanze ituro imbere y'Imana, ariko iryanjye ntiryakiriwe mu gihe irindi turo ryari ryemejwe.
Navuze mfite ishyari kandi nshaka kwica umuntu.
Ninjye wakoze ubwicanyi bwa mbere butari bwo ku isi.
Nabonye igikona kirimo gukurura hasi kugira ngo kinyereke uko nahisha umurambo.
Nasigaye nicuza cyane maze mba mu batsinzwe n'ibyo amaboko yanjye yari yakoze.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Kwica umuvandimwe kubera ishyari nyuma yo kwangwa igitambo
Kubaka umunara muremure wo kureba ijuru
Gushushanya inyana ya zahabu yo gusengwa
Kuyobora ingabo z'inzovu kugira ngo zisenye Kaaba
trial.answer: Kwica umuvandimwe kubera ishyari nyuma yo kwangwa igitambo

location.answer: Igikona kirimo gukurura ubutaka kugira ngo yerekane ko cyashyinguwe

outcome.answer: Yabaye umuntu wicuza kandi ari mu batsinzwe

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
